## Checklist

- [ ] I verified the site builds locally: `bundle exec jekyll build`
- [ ] If I changed `Gemfile` or `.ruby-version`, I regenerated the lockfile
      (`bundle lock`) and the committed `Gemfile.lock` is current
- [ ] If I changed `_data/`, `_config.yml`, or the site tooling, I regenerated
      the derived content (`_pages/`, OpenAPI files) and included the output
- [ ] If I changed a GitHub Actions workflow, I pinned/updated the action
      SHAs (Dependabot keeps these current — do not float tags back)
- [ ] I updated any affected documentation
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for accidental secrets or generated artifacts
